prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an original premium graphic-novel editorial illustration, wide cinematic 16:9, for ARC MUTANTS grinding through the final weekend of ARC-AGI-2. NEW SCENE, not a repeat of the reference's posed courtyard poster.

Input 1 is the user's exact team picture: primary character identity, intricate inked graphical style, costumes, cybernetic hardware and academy architecture reference. Inputs 2, 3 and 4 are supporting individual identity references for JACK, MARK, SON respectively; ignore every historical label and statistic on input2. Keep EXACTLY the FOUR established adult men. RONEN's identity is the opaque violet grid helmet in input1; his face remains fully concealed. No other people or animals.

Scene: THE LAB THAT WOULD NOT SLEEP. At blue midnight inside a vast vaulted experimental workshop beneath the academy, all four are STILL WORKING in a candid, intensely kinetic moment. Perspective from just above the front edge of a cluttered circular laboratory bench, moderately wide; all four characters large enough to recognize, distinct silhouettes, anatomically believable hands and purposeful actions. A spectacular experimental puzzle accelerator at center: layered transparent square ARC input/output grids held in intersecting mechanical rings, colored square cells shattering outward as one test misfires; cyan geometric light paths visibly connect a test grid to its transformed output. Show clean square-cell grid geometry, discrete colored cells and actual simple colored shape transformations, not illegible pseudo-code or uniform screens.

MARK at left, rugged bearded lower face, immense asymmetric exposed GPU backpack and elaborate circuit-screen headgear from the reference, teal and amber armor, short glowing circuit-prong gauntlets: leaning into a half-open GPU server rack and reseating a cable while containing amber sparks. JACK near center in his hovering command chair, calm square-jawed clean-shaven face beneath his distinctive wide cyan visor and central circuit-board headset, elegant navy/gold long academy coat: one hand delicately recalibrating the accelerator's floating colored input/output grids, the other on the chair's control desk. SON foreground right, the familiar younger Asian face and friendly determined lower face, thick black GPU headgear and broad cyan visor, streamlined dark suit: leaning over a submission console with one hand on its physical controls and the other catching a misaligned grid plane, energetic but not posing at the camera. RONEN behind and right, tall opaque violet-edged grid helmet, tailored dark geometric coat and violet gauntlets: projecting a translucent shield made of colored square cells to catch the runaway experiment, fully visible helmet and torso.

Narrative details must communicate last-minute experimental runs, queued submissions and platform errors without invented leaderboard outcomes: multiple holographic monitor panels with red warning triangles, red broken-link icons, amber stalled horizontal progress bars, a small clock silhouette, a queue of uncompleted square tiles; one panel shows a submission-path arrow hitting an error symbol. A few cups, notes with colored grid doodles, tangled data cables and warm work lights around the bench, technically intricate but readable. No successful final result, trophy, victory pose, rank, score, hardware brand claim, or literal Kaggle logo. All machinery is fantastical editorial metaphor.

Style: match input1's beautifully drawn cyberpunk graphic novel, sophisticated hand-inked linework, expressive idealized illustrated lower faces, immense lovingly drawn GPU rigs, rich cinematic depth and handsome academy architecture. Deep midnight blue and cyan with amber practical lighting, restrained magenta/violet energy, nuanced luminous material texture. Nervous comic energy and stubborn camaraderie, not gloomy defeat. Different action, setting and camera from all static ensemble images. Keep the TOP LEFT about 22% width and 15% height relatively uncluttered dark architectural space for a programmatically added title, without covering a face. Render NO TEXT OR LETTERING, no logos, captions, names, ranks, digits, scores, signatures or watermarks. The ARC MUTANTS / ARC-AGI-2 masthead and ERROR/QUEUED/RETRY screen labels will be added afterward in code. Preserve the exact four character identities and their individualized hardware.

references.role: User-supplied primary four-person cast and graphical style reference.
Jack Cole individual identity; ignore printed historical labels and statistics.

review: Four established ARC2 characters preserved: bearded Mark at GPU rack, Jack with circuit visor and command chair, Son at submission console, opaque violet-helmet Ronen containing grids. New night workshop action; discrete input/output grids, stalled queues, warning symbols, no score or victory claim. Clean native original retained; deterministic title and small queue/error labels added separately.
